verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a mesh VPN and connectivity platform. A user-defined background automation or agent-scheduling engine falls outside its product category, so this axis does not apply. The automation-related evidence does not show Tailscale itself running autonomous background automations: IaC providers and webhooks drive or notify from outside the product, iOS Shortcuts is a host-platform feature, and the time-limited ACL reset relies on a user-built Slack bot.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
